mechanism: Valganciclovir may cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities, which can potentiate candesartan's effects on renal function and blood pressure regulation, particularly in patients with pre-existing renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR), electrolytes (potassium), and blood pressure regularly during concurrent use; adjust candesartan dose if renal function declines significantly.
